clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Shrine of Aessina, Illiyana keeps watch over the woods of southwestern Ashenvale. The ancient dryad protects the woodland from corruption and calls on Alliance champions to drive back the satyrs.

Illiyana patrols the woods of southwestern Ashenvale as one of Cenarius's daughters. Dryads live in peace, yet fiercely defend wild lands. As corruption spreads through the woodland, Illiyana guards sacred relics and groves, keeping watch over nature's primal sanctity.

Satyrs remain a threat to the glades and Illiyana's dryad sisters. These twisted, demonic creatures seek to corrupt the woods. Illiyana calls on travelers to slay them and recover lost relics, including the Branch of Cenarius, so the woodland stays free of demonic taint.
